notes: Owner's manuals: VIN required for every model/year (Digital Owner's Manual form 'vinCodeForm' on bmwusa.com/owners-manuals.html; the 'Select a Series' links only go to marketing pages). Free: US Service & Warranty Information / New Vehicle Limited Warranty booklets and Maintenance booklets per model year, from the official selector on bmwusa.com (JSON endpoint bin/services/warranty-books). Booklets are multi-model (e.g. 3/5/7 Series, X1-X6, M models); from MY2023 BMW publishes one all-model warranty booklet and one all-model maintenance booklet. MY2024-2026 M cars are listed only under series 'the-m' (BMW M, all models) - mapped to m3/m5/x5-m/x6-m where the model existed. Tire manufacturers' warranty guides were also listed but are excluded. bmwusa.com blocks non-browser HTTP clients (timeouts); all data and Range checks were made from a real browser session on bmwusa.com. A few PDFs (2019/2020 X7 warranty, 2022 X3M-X6M warranty) ignored the Range header (HTTP 200).
